about.description: edge tag: this entity is about that one

by.description: who archived it — kept as history when that entity is deleted

via.description: what the write was made through — the session or client it came in on

archived.description: Hidden from ordinary listings, without stopping execution or deleting history.

by.description: who found it broken — kept as history when that entity is deleted

via.description: what the write came in through — the session or client that made it

code.description: the other side's word for what broke: an OAuth error code, a hostname check's status

broken.description: Something outside the graph stopped honoring what this entity holds: a connection whose grant was revoked, a hostname whose check failed. It is a standing condition of a long-lived thing, not one refusal. Removing the mark says it holds again.

comment.description: a comment on any entity; the doc component beside it holds the text

hash.description: the cited entity's content hash when this citation was verified

cites.description: this entity cites that one; its hash says whether the cited content still holds

by.description: who finished it — kept as history when that entity is deleted

via.description: what the write came in through — the session or client that made it

completed.description: The work this entity records was finished: a task done. Who finished it is kept across later writes of the mark. Removing the mark reopens the work.

created.description: who made it, when, and through what

decided.description: the decision itself: approved or declined, by whom and when

delegates.description: edge tag: this entity handed work off to that one

archetype.description: the archetype entity describing this one's set of components, not a type name

entity.description: every entity has one: the identity row, carrying the archetype its set of components adds up to and whatever else a plugin keeps beside every entity

by.description: who gave up on it — kept as history when that entity is deleted

via.description: what the write came in through — the session or client that made it

reason.description: why it failed, in the words of whatever refused

failed.description: The work this entity records was tried and given up on, and is not tried again on its own: a checkout that could not be made. Removing the mark says it is being tried again.

image.description: this entity is an image, with its pixel dimensions

proposed.description: put forward for a decision, by whom and when

quarantined.description: set aside as harmful to act on: readable, never handed out as guidance

reads.description: edge tag: this entity reads that one

hash.description: the digest of what was there, so a claim about it can still be checked

redaction.description: one property of one entity, replaced — the hash proves what was there without keeping it

references.description: edge tag: this entity refers to that one

by.description: who resolved it — kept as history when that entity is deleted

via.description: what the write was made through — the session or client it came in on, or the deploy that resolved it

resolved.description: The problem this entity records has stopped happening: a bug a deploy fixed, a comment thread that was settled, a conflict between two sessions that is over. It is not `completed`, which says a piece of work was finished; a problem can stop with no task done. Removing the mark says the problem is back.

supersedes.description: edge tag: this entity replaces that one

supervises.description: edge tag: this entity oversees that one

updated.description: who last changed it, when, and through what

verified.description: somebody checked this entity against what it claims and found it holds; only the act of checking writes it, never an edit to the entity

wants.description: edge tag: this entity wants that one

worked.description: edge tag: this entity worked on that one

comment_new.title: Comment on an entity
comment_new.description: Create a comment on an entity: a new stored record with doc{body} holding the text and comment{target} linking to its subject, attributed to the caller. The target can be any entity: a task, a design, a session, another comment. Returns the applied changes as bundles: JSON objects with entity ids and the components (named groups of fields) written or removed.

target.description: the entity the comment is about; pass its id or registered name

at.description: when the child took a place

by.description: who wrote the mark — kept as history when that entity is deleted

via.description: what the write came in through — the session or client that made it

admitted.description: A child holds a place under the concurrency bound. Removing the mark gives up that place.

by.description: who wrote the mark — kept as history when that entity is deleted

via.description: what the write came in through — the session or client that made it

waiting.description: A child has stepped aside while it waits for its own children. Removing the mark queues it again.
